eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Plumas, CA; at 4:08 PM on AUG 24, 2020 Effective until 6:08 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
This is the Plumas County Sheriffs Office with an Evacuation Advisory Alert for the residents of Chandler Road to Carol Lane East due to a wildfire
Please make preparations to evacuate. If you have special needs you may want to evacuate now
If you have large animals you should make arrangements to move them immediately
